info.title: Factuarea Public API
info.description:
Public REST API for invoicing in Spain — manage invoices, quotes, proformas, delivery notes, products, clients and webhooks.

## Authentication

The API authenticates with a secret **API key**, sent on every request as:

```
Authorization: Bearer fact_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

or, alternatively, in the `X-API-Key` header. The key is issued from the Factuarea portal and must NEVER be exposed in public clients (browser, mobile apps).

## Environments: `live` and `test`

Each API key belongs to one of two environments, unambiguously identifiable by its **prefix**:

| Prefix | Environment | Data it operates on | External effects |
|---------|---------|---------------------------|------------------|
| `fact_live_` | **live** (production) | Your real company | Real: legal fiscal numbering, VeriFactu→AEAT, emails to clients, outbound webhooks |
| `fact_test_` | **test** (sandbox) | An isolated *sandbox* company | **Neutralized** (see below) |

The prefix is the **source of truth** for the environment: a `fact_test_` key always operates in test mode and a `fact_live_` key always in live. There is no request parameter that changes the environment — it is determined by the key.

### Data isolation (sandbox)

`fact_test_` keys operate on a dedicated **sandbox company** (a technical "twin company" of the account holder, automatically provisioned the first time test mode is used, which inherits the plan of your real company for faithful *feature-gating*). Thanks to per-company data isolation:

- Resources created with a `fact_test_` key are **not visible** from a `fact_live_` key, and vice versa.
- Test fiscal numbering uses the sandbox's own series and **never** consumes or alters the sequential numbering of your production series.

The functional surface is **identical** in both environments: the same endpoints and operations are available in test as in live.

### External effects neutralized in test

When you operate with a `fact_test_` key (sandbox environment), outbound effects are **disabled** so you can test your integration without real consequences:

- **VeriFactu**: the Alta record is created locally, but **not transmitted to AEAT**.
- **Email**: document emails are **not delivered** to real recipients.
- **Webhooks**: events are **not delivered** to your external HTTP endpoints.

In `live`, all these effects fire normally.

> **Recommendation**: always integrate and test first with a `fact_test_` key. Once your flow works, switch to the `fact_live_` prefix to operate in production.

post.description:
Delete several invoices in one call with partial success — each id is evaluated independently and one failure never aborts the batch. Only draft invoices are deleted; an issued invoice comes back as a `resource_not_deletable` failure (use `void` instead). Returns a `BulkPartialSuccessResult` with `total`, `successful`, `failed` and a per-id `failures` list.

```json
{ "ids": ["0190a1b2-c3d4-7e5f-8a90-1b2c3d4e5f60", "0190a1b2-c3d4-7e5f-8a90-1b2c3d4e5f61"] }
```

Limits: `ids` accepts 1–100 UUID v7 entries per call.

Limits: `ids` accepts 1–50 entries; `payment_date` is required when `new_status` is `paid` and must not be in the future.

parameters.description: Cuando es truthy (`1`/`true`), fuerza `Content-Disposition: attachment` (descarga de fichero) en lugar de `inline`.

200.description: Binary PDF stream of the delivery note (`application/pdf`). Use `?download=1` to receive `Content-Disposition: attachment` (forces a file download); otherwise the disposition is `inline`. The response carries an `ETag`; send it back via `If-None-Match` to get a `304 Not Modified` when the PDF has not changed.

ETag.description: Entity tag of the PDF (`sha1` of uuid + updated_at). Send it back in `If-None-Match` to leverage the 304 cache.

Content-Disposition.description: Disposition of the PDF: `inline; filename="…"` by default, or `attachment; filename="…"` when `?download=1` is passed (RFC 5987 `filename*` included for UTF-8 names).

GET /v1/invoices/export?format=SUMMARY&status=paid&date_from=2026-01-01&date_to=2026-03-31

Limits: the selection is capped at 5,000 invoices; a wider one returns 422 `export_limit_exceeded`.

get.description:
Retrieve a series by its `uuid`.

Series are **immutable** for fiscal compliance (AEAT VeriFactu — legal numbering continuity): `PUT`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` on `/v1/series/{uuid}` return `405 Method Not Allowed` with `error.code = "series_immutable"` and header `Allow: GET, POST`. To "delete" a series use `POST /v1/series/{uuid}/archive`; to change the numbering, create a new series and mark it as default.

OAuth2.description:
OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with PKCE (`code_challenge_method=S256`).
Discovery metadata (RFC 8414) is published at `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`.

## API key rotation policy

API keys and OAuth client secrets are long-lived credentials and MUST be rotated periodically and immediately after any suspected leak.

- **Prefixes**: every key carries an unambiguous environment prefix — `fact_live_` (production) and `fact_test_` (sandbox). The prefix is the source of truth for the environment; never mix them across environments.
- **How to rotate**: rotate an API key from the Factuarea portal (or via the self-service `account:write` endpoints). Rotation issues a brand-new secret and returns it **once** — store it immediately, it is never shown again.
- **Grace window (dual-secret)**: after a rotation the previous secret keeps working for a **24-hour grace window**, so you can roll out the new secret with zero downtime. During that window both the new and the previous secret are accepted; once the window expires the previous secret is rejected and purged.
- **When to rotate**: on a regular schedule (e.g. every 90 days), whenever a teammate with access leaves, and **immediately** if a secret is ever exposed in logs, source control or a public client.
- Secrets are bound to a single company (tenant) and MUST NEVER be embedded in browsers, mobile apps or any public client — keep them server-side only.

BulkCreateResult.description: Result of a bulk invoice creation (`POST /v1/invoices/bulk-create`). `dry_run` reports the mode. In validate-only mode (`dry_run=true`) `results[]` carries the per-row classification `{index, status, errors[], warnings[]}` and nothing is persisted; in create mode (`dry_run=false`) only valid rows are created and `failures[]` carries the rows that were not created (identified by `index`). `total = successful + failed`.

dry_run.description: Whether the operation ran in validate-only mode (no invoice was created).

successful.description: Number of rows that validated successfully (`dry_run=true`) or were created (`dry_run=false`).

failed.description: Number of rows that were invalid or could not be created. Equals `failures` length in create mode.

results.description: Per-row classification of validate-only mode (`dry_run=true`). Empty in create mode.

items.description: Classification of a single new row of the batch, identified by its 0-based `index`.

index.description: 0-based position of the row within the batch.

status.description: Row status: `valid` (would be created without error) or `invalid` (has blocking errors).

errors.description: Per-field blocking issues of the row. Empty when the row is valid.

warnings.description: Per-field non-blocking warnings of the row (e.g. recipient not found in the AEAT census). Empty when there are none.

failures.description: Rows that could not be created (create mode, `dry_run=false`). Each item carries the 0-based `index`, an `error_code`, a Spanish `error_message` and the per-field `errors[]`. Empty in validate-only mode.

items.description: A row that could not be created, identified by its 0-based `index`.

index.description: 0-based position of the row within the batch.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code from the v1 error catalog (stable across languages).

error_message.description: Human-readable reason for the failure, in Spanish.

errors.description: Per-field blocking issues that made the row invalid.

BulkCreateResult.title: BulkCreateResult

BulkPartialSuccessResult.description: Result of a bulk or import operation that reports per-resource status. `total` is how many rows/resources were processed (`successful + failed`), `successful` how many were applied (deleted, created or validated) and `failed` how many could not be processed. `failures[]` carries one item per failed row. Shape shared by every bulk endpoint of the public API (the `/v1/{resource}/bulk-delete` endpoints emit it today). Anchored integrators before `2026-09-01` keep receiving the previous `{object, deleted, failed[{id, reason}]}` shape via `Factuarea-Version`.

successful.description: Number of rows/resources processed successfully (deleted, created or validated).

failed.description: Number of rows/resources that could not be processed. Equals `failures` length.

failures.description: One item per failed row/resource. Always a list (empty, never `null`, when there are no failures).

items.description: A failed row/resource. Identity is polymorphic: `id` for an existing resource (bulk-delete/bulk-send/bulk-pdf), or `index` for a new row without a resource yet (bulk-create with `dry_run`, import CSV). Exactly one of `id`/`index` is present.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the existing resource that could not be processed. Present for bulk operations over existing resources (e.g. bulk-delete).

index.description: 0-based position of the row within the batch. Present for new rows without a resource yet (bulk-create with `dry_run`, import CSV).

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code from the v1 error catalog (stable across languages). For bulk-delete: `resource_not_found` or `resource_not_deletable`.

error_message.description: Human-readable reason for the failure, in Spanish (internal messages are not exposed).

errors.description: Per-field blocking issues (validate-only / bulk-create flows). Empty or absent for bulk-delete.

warnings.description: Per-field non-blocking warnings (validate-only / bulk-create flows). Empty or absent for bulk-delete.

simplified_threshold_cents.description: Simplified invoice (F2) threshold in cents for this account, range `[0, 300000]` (0–3,000 €). Defaults to 40000 (400 €).

require_nif.description: Whether a Spanish tax ID (NIF) is required for auto-invoicing on this account. Defaults to `false`.

refunds_enabled.description: Whether a Stripe refund (`charge.refunded`) on this account automatically generates a linked corrective invoice. Defaults to `true`.

subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled.description: Whether Stripe subscription cycles on this account are auto-invoiced. Defaults to `false`.

status.description: Account status. `active` while connected; `disconnected` (terminal) after disconnecting (invoices and history are kept).

connected_at.description: When the account was connected (ISO 8601), or `null` if unknown.

ConnectedAccount.title: ConnectedAccount

ConvertProformaRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — POST /v1/proformas/{uuid}/convert.

Required body: `target` ∈ {invoice}. Only conversion to invoice is
supported — other targets (`proforma`, `delivery_note`) do NOT apply
because a proforma can only be converted to an invoice by BC design.
ConvertProformaRequest.title: ConvertProformaRequest

CreateApiKeyV1Request.description: Create an API key for your own tenant. The `tier` is never accepted from the body — it is derived from the holder plan and add-ons. Requested `scopes` must belong to the closed v1 catalog and stay within the holder plan; a scope above the plan returns 422.

name.description: Human-readable name for the API key (1-120 characters).

expires_at.description: Future ISO 8601 date after which the key stops authenticating.

scopes.description: List of scopes from the closed v1 catalog (at least one).

ip_allowlist.description: Optional list of allowed IPs / CIDR ranges (IPv4, IPv6, /N).

CreateApiKeyV1Request.title: CreateApiKeyV1Request

CreateChildApiKeyV1Request.description: Issue an API key scoped to one of your managed child companies. The plaintext secret is returned once in the creation response. Requested `scopes` must belong to the closed v1 catalog and be a subset of the calling key scopes; the environment and tier are never accepted from the body.

name.description: Human-readable name for the API key (1-120 characters).

expires_at.description: Future ISO 8601 date after which the key stops authenticating.

scopes.description: List of scopes from the closed v1 catalog (at least one; a subset of the parent key scopes).

ip_allowlist.description: Optional list of allowed IPs / CIDR ranges (IPv4, IPv6, /N).

CreateChildApiKeyV1Request.title: CreateChildApiKeyV1Request

type.description: Alternative identifier type from the AEAT L7 catalog. Legacy aliases (`tax_id_foreign`/`national_id`) are accepted on input for backward compatibility.

CreateCompanyV1Request.description: Register a managed child company under your master tenant. `name` and `tax_id` are required; the rest of the profile (business name, fiscal address, contact details) is optional. `tax_id` is validated as a Spanish tax ID (NIF/CIF/NIE) and must be unique among the companies you manage; `country_aeat_zone` is derived from the postal code.

name.description: Trade name of the child company (1-255 characters).

tax_id.description: Spanish tax identifier (NIF, CIF or NIE). Immutable after creation.

business_name.description: Legal/registered business name of the child company.

email.description: Contact email of the child company.

CreateCompanyV1Request.title: CreateCompanyV1Request

CreateCorrectiveInvoiceRequest.description: Generate a corrective (rectificativa) invoice for a previously issued invoice. `correction_reason` (required) maps to a VeriFactu R-code; `correction_type` is `full` or `partial`; the optional `correction_code` (`R1`..`R5`) forces the explicit R-code and is validated against the AEAT legal matrix for the original invoice type. Optional `justification`, `notes`, and `lines[]` (required when `correction_type` is `partial`).
CreateCorrectiveInvoiceRequest.title: CreateCorrectiveInvoiceRequest

vehicle_plate.description: Licence plate of the vehicle used for the delivery (up to 20 characters).

CreateInvoiceRequest.description: Create a sales invoice. Required: `client_id`, `series_id`, `issued_on`, `due_on` and `lines[]` (at least one). Optional: `notes`, `metadata`, `tags`, `custom_fields`, and an `options` object to atomically create, issue, send and wait for the PDF in a single call. Without `options` the invoice is created as a draft.
CreateInvoiceRequest.title: CreateInvoiceRequest

CreateProductRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — POST /v1/products.

Required body: `name`, `price`. Optional: `sku`, `description`, `tags`,
`stock` (initial quantity), `low_stock_threshold` (per-product),
`currency` (EUR only — Producto is read-only EUR; any other code → 422),
`tax_rate_id`, `is_active`, `metadata`, `external_id`.
Validation of `metadata` via VO `Metadata`.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit (your own product code), unique per company. Optional; up to 100 characters.

stock.description: Initial stock (create only; later stock changes are made via `PUT /v1/products/{uuid}/stock`). Absent → defaults to 0.

currency.description:
Producto es read-only EUR: solo se admite `EUR` (o ausencia/null).
Cualquier otra moneda → 422 (antes se aceptaba-y-descartaba).

tax_rate_id.description:
`taxes` is a global system catalog (without a `company_id` column).
Do NOT use TenantRule here — it would add `WHERE company_id = X` against a
table without that column and cause a 500 (SQLSTATE 42S22). Global
validation by uuid, like in the rest of the BCs (DeliveryNote V1, etc.).

external_id.description: Third-party integration key from your ERP/CRM (orthogonal to `sku`). Free-form, up to 100 characters.

CreateProductRequest.title: CreateProductRequest

external_id.description: External business key (integration key from your ERP/CRM), unique per company. Orthogonal to `external_invoice_number` (the supplier fiscal number): `external_id` is the resource ID in the integrator system.

status.description:
Optional initial status. 4-state model:
CREATION allowlist `draft|pending` (`received`/`pending_payment`
were merged into `pending`). `paid|cancelled` are lifecycle
transitions (mark_paid/change_status), NOT creation states.
If omitted, the domain applies the default `draft`.

internal_notes.description:
Extend fields. Basic SHAPE only; the `payment_method` allowlist,
`tax_period` format and `tags` cardinality are validated by the
VO/Aggregate.

operation_class.description: Classifies the origin of the expense for the input VAT of Modelo 303 (boxes [28]-[39]). Closed set; nullable → defaults to `corriente`.

exclude_347.description: Whether to exclude this purchase invoice from the annual Modelo 347 declaration.

custom_fields.description: Typed custom fields as `[{field, value}]`. `field` up to 60 characters (non-empty), `value` up to 500 characters, up to 50 entries.

retention_rate.description: Per-line IRPF retention and deductible VAT. `retention_rate` is the percentage withheld from the supplier (0–100); `vat_deductible` flags VAT deductibility (informational, does not change the amount paid).

surcharge_rate.description: Per-line equivalence surcharge (the legal VAT↔surcharge pair is validated) and LIVA exemption reason (closed catalog).

indirect_tax_regime.description: Per-line indirect tax regime of the supplier. Passthrough only (purchase lines have no `tax_id`): the incoming override is the sole regime channel; the real invariant lives in the domain.

CreateRecurringFromInvoiceRequest.description: Create a recurring invoice from an existing invoice, reusing its lines, client and series. The body supplies only the recurrence configuration: `frequency` and `start_on` are required; `end_on`, `name`, `description`, `notes`, `metadata`, `holiday_handling`, `days_before_due`, `max_occurrences` and an `auto_delivery` object are optional.
CreateRecurringFromInvoiceRequest.title: CreateRecurringFromInvoiceRequest

CreateRecurringInvoiceRequest.description: Create a recurring invoice template that auto-generates invoices on a fixed cadence. Required: `client_id`, `series_id`, `frequency`, `start_on` and `lines[]` (at least one). Optional: `end_on`, `name`, `description`, `notes`, `metadata`, `holiday_handling`, `days_before_due`, `max_occurrences`, `email_to`, `send_automatically`, `tags` and `custom_fields`. `frequency` accepts `daily`, `weekly`, `biweekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semiannual` or `yearly`.
CreateRecurringInvoiceRequest.title: CreateRecurringInvoiceRequest

type.description: Alternative identifier type from the AEAT L7 catalog. Legacy aliases (`tax_id_foreign`/`national_id`) are accepted on input for backward compatibility.

customer_visible_label.description: Custom label for this tax shown to the customer on documents (e.g. "IVA 21% incluido"). Up to 200 characters.

valid_until.description: End date of the tax validity window (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Must be on or after `valid_from`.

linked_surcharge_taxes_id.description: FK to the linked equivalence-surcharge tax. UUID v7 value referencing the global `taxes` catalog.

default_for_documents.description: Sets this tax as the default per document type. Object with optional booleans: `invoice`, `quote`, `delivery_note`, `proforma`, `purchase_invoice`, `recurring_invoice`.

CustomField.description: A typed custom field as an ordered `{field, value}` pair. Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata.
CustomField.title: CustomField

CustomHeaders.description: Custom HTTP headers (string → string) added to every delivery request for a webhook endpoint. Max 20 entries, each value ≤ 1024 chars. Header names are normalized to Title-Case. Reserved names (`Host`, `Content-Type`, `Factuarea-Signature`, `X-Forwarded-*`, …) are rejected. Empty object when none are set. Never put secrets here — values are returned verbatim by the API.
CustomHeaders.title: CustomHeaders

system_id.description: Identifier of the invoicing software system (SIF).

system_name.description: Name of the invoicing software system.

producer_tax_id.description: Tax ID (NIF) of the SIF producer.

verifactu_only.description: Indicates whether the system operates only in VeriFactu mode (tipo_uso = "S").

signing_place.description: Place where the declaration is signed.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the declaration content for integrity verification (the full content is not exposed).

DeliveryNote.description: A delivery note tracking goods delivered to a customer.

status.description: Delivery note lifecycle status exposed by the public API: `draft` (created, editable), `sent` (goods marked as delivered, no signature recorded yet), `signed` (delivered AND a recipient signature has been recorded), `invoiced` (converted into an invoice, terminal), `cancelled` (terminal). Note: the internal `delivered` state is surfaced as `sent` (without signature) or `signed` (with signature) — there is no `delivered` value in the public API. Recording a signature on a `sent` note moves it to `signed` (it does not introduce a brand-new lifecycle stage; the signature presence is the only difference).

vehicle_plate.description: License plate of the delivery vehicle.

name.description: Driver name.

driver.description: Delivery driver data. `null` when no sub-field is provided.

tracking.description: Shipment tracking data. `null` when no sub-field is provided.

name.description: Name of the person who received the goods.

received_by.description: Goods recipient data. `null` when no sub-field is provided.

billing_emails.description: Additional emails for delivery note dispatch (administration, accounting). Maximum 5. Empty `[]` when there are none.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

tags.description: Free classification tags (lowercase slugs `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 40 chars each, ≤ 30 tags). Filterable via `?tags[in]=tag1,tag2` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics). Empty `[]` when there are none.

custom_fields.description: Ordered list of typed custom fields `[{field, value}]` (≤ 50). Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata. Empty `[]` when there are none.

converted_to_id.description: UUID (v7) of the invoice this delivery note was converted into.

DeliveryNote.title: DeliveryNote

DeliveryNoteLine.description: A line item on a delivery note.

description.example: Cajas de material A4 (500u)

retention_rate.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime of the line: the per-document override (`iva`/`igic`/`ipsi`) when the user set it (precedence override>zone), otherwise `null` (derived from the establishment AEAT zone). Writable per-document input on create/update; the document must be homogeneous (a single non-null regime across all lines, 422 otherwise).

DeliveryNoteLine.title: DeliveryNoteLine

DeliveryNoteStats.description: Resumen agregado de los albaranes de la empresa autenticada: total, importe acumulado, desglose por estado interno, pendientes de firma y convertidos a factura este mes. Devuelto por `GET /v1/delivery_notes/stats`.

total_count.description: Total number of recorded delivery notes.

total_amount.description: Aggregate amount of the delivery notes (EUR).

by_status.description: Breakdown by internal delivery note state. The key is the internal state (`draft`, `delivered`, `invoiced`, `cancelled`); the value is an object with `status`, `count` and `total` (accumulated amount in EUR). States with no delivery notes do not appear.

status.description: Internal state of the delivery note.

count.description: Number of delivery notes in that state.

total.description: Aggregate amount of the delivery notes in that status (EUR).

pending_signature.description: Delivered delivery notes (`delivered`) that do not yet have a recorded signature.

converted_this_month.description: Delivery notes converted to an invoice (`invoiced`) during the current month.

DeliveryNoteStats.title: DeliveryNoteStats

color.description: Suggested color for rendering the status in the UI.

code.description: Stable error code, e.g. missing_api_key, insufficient_scope, parameter_invalid, invalid_status_transition. Full reference of every code grouped by bounded context: https://docs.factuarea.com/guides/errors/all.

subcode.description: Sub-code detailing the subtype within `code`. Only present on some 409 errors — e.g. `code=resource_already_exists`, `subcode=tax_id_already_exists` to indicate exactly which duplicate key triggered the conflict.

message.example: No se ha proporcionado una API key válida en el header Authorization.
examples: No se ha proporcionado una API key válida en el header Authorization.

param.description: Field that caused the error (for parameter_invalid and similar invalid_request_error codes). On multi-field validation errors it points to the FIRST failed field; the full set lives in `errors[]`.

errors.description: Present on 422 validation errors: ALL failed fields, one item per field (not only the first). Each item carries `param`/`code`/`message` plus the optional hints `expected_format`/`allowed_values`. Additive and backward-compatible — `error.param`/`error.message` still mirror the first failed field.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code for this field, derived from the failed validation rule (e.g. parameter_missing, parameter_invalid_format, parameter_invalid_enum).

message.description: Human-readable description of the field error. Localized (es/en/ca) when its `code` belongs to the stable catalog.

expected_format.description: Expected format hint (e.g. `YYYY-MM-DD`, `uuid`, `email`, `url`). Only present when the failure is a format error.

allowed_values.description: Legal values of the enum. Only present when the failure is an enum/`in` error.

details.description: Present on 409 duplication conflicts (subcodes `tax_id_already_exists`, `external_id_already_exists`, `sku_already_exists`): structured details about the conflict.

existing_resource_id.description: UUID of the pre-existing resource that triggered the conflict. Resolvable with a `GET /v1/{resource}/{id}` without an extra `find_by_*` call.

doc_url.description: Link to error reference in docs.

Event.description: A read-only record of something that happened in your account. The same object is delivered to your webhook endpoints.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the event, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`). Consistent with the `id` field of every other v1 resource.

object.description: Always `event`.

type.description: Event type in `<category>.<action>` form (e.g. `invoice.paid`, `quote.approved`). See `GET /event-catalog` for the full list.

aggregate_id.description: UUID v7 of the resource that produced this event (e.g. the invoice for `invoice.paid`). `null` for events without backfill. Distinct from `id`, which identifies the event itself.

correlation_id.description: UUID v7 correlating this event end-to-end with the operation that produced it. `null` for events without a correlation context (e.g. born from scheduler sweeps). The key is always present.

api_version.description: API version (date-based) the payload was serialized under, sealed at emission (e.g. `2026-05-22`). `null` only for legacy events emitted before versions were sealed.

livemode.description: `true` for events generated in production (live keys, `fact_live_`); `false` for events generated in test mode (sandbox company, test keys `fact_test_`).

test.description: `true` when the event is a test delivery triggered from the dashboard; `false` for real events. Orthogonal to `livemode`, which reflects the key environment (live vs sandbox): a test delivery may be issued in either, so e.g. `livemode: true, test: true` is valid.

Invoice.description: A sales invoice (compliant with Spanish AEAT VeriFactu).

number.description: Definitive invoice number, or `null` for drafts (where `is_number_assigned` is `false`).

is_number_assigned.description: Whether the invoice has a definitive number assigned. `false` for drafts (where `number` is `null`); becomes `true` after `POST /v1/invoices/{uuid}/assign-real-number`, or automatically on send/payment.

type.description: AEAT invoice type code: `F1` (ordinaria), `F2` (simplificada), `F3` (sustitutiva de simplificadas), `R1`–`R5` (rectificativa).

status.description: Invoice lifecycle status.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

tags.description: Free classification tags (lowercase slugs `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 40 chars each, ≤ 30 tags). Filterable via `?tags[in]=tag1,tag2` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics). Empty `[]` when there are none.

custom_fields.description: Ordered list of typed custom fields `[{field, value}]` (≤ 50). Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata. Empty `[]` when there are none.

exemption_reason.description: VAT exemption cause per document (AEAT catalog E1..E6), or `null` when not exempt. Read-only: the public API derives the AEAT qualification from the regime/cause at issuance.

legal_mentions.description: Header legal mentions (includes the mention derived from the exemption cause). Read-only.

exclude_347.description: Read-only flag: whether this invoice is excluded from the annual Modelo 347 report. The public API cannot mutate it (the create/update FormRequest does not accept it); managing the flag is exclusive to the internal app.

verifactu_status.description: Status of the AEAT VeriFactu submission.

paid_amount.description: Amount already collected for this invoice (derived from the payment ledger). Satisfies the invariant `paid_amount + pending_amount === total`.

pending_amount.description: Outstanding balance pending collection for this invoice (derived from the payment ledger).

payments.description: Payment ledger summary, ALWAYS present (never `null`). `total` mirrors `paid_amount`, `pending` mirrors `pending_amount`. `detail` lists the individual payments and is materialized ONLY on the show endpoint (`GET /v1/invoices/{id}`); in list responses `detail` is `[]` (by cost) while `total`/`pending` stay populated. The detail is also available via `GET /v1/invoices/{id}/payments`.

detail.description: List of individual payments. Empty `[]` in list responses or when there are no payments yet.

is_corrective.description: Whether this invoice is a corrective (rectificativa) of another invoice.

scheduled_for.description: Scheduled emission timestamp (ISO 8601), or `null` when the invoice is not scheduled. Populated only while `status` is `scheduled`.

scheduled_action.description: Action the scheduler runs when `scheduled_for` is reached: `issue_and_send` (issue and email) or `draft` (issue only). `null` when the invoice is not scheduled.

Invoice.title: Invoice

InvoiceActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of an invoice. Groups domain events originated by changes to the invoice itself (creation, sending, payment, correction, etc.).

event_type.description: Tipo de evento de dominio (p. ej. `invoice.created`, `invoice.paid`).

description.description: Human-readable description of the event in Spanish.
description.example: La factura se marcó como cobrada por transferencia bancaria.
examples: La factura se marcó como cobrada por transferencia bancaria.

metadata.description: Event metadata. Internal identifiers (PKs) are stripped; `*_uuid` values are preserved.

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

Metadata.description:
A free map of up to 50 key→value pairs for storing arbitrary structured data (values are strings up to 500 characters). Unlike `custom_fields` — an ordered list of typed `{field, value}` pairs with display semantics, present on the six document resources — `metadata` is an unordered map for opaque integration data; a document may carry both. The master resources (Client, Supplier) have no `custom_fields`, so their `metadata` doubles as the custom-fields store.

**Reserved keys (read-only).** When the system auto-issues an invoice from a payment correlation (Stripe/GoCardless/MONEI), it writes `stripe_subscription_id`, `stripe_invoice_id`, `billing_reason`, `period_start` and `period_end` into that invoice metadata automatically. Do not set or overwrite them by hand — the platform owns them and a manual value may be replaced when the correlation runs.

The cursor is opaque — clients MUST NOT interpret it. Concrete listings narrow `data` to their resource type via `allOf`.

has_more.description: Whether more pages are available after this one.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page (UUID v7), or `null` when `has_more` is `false`.

RecurringInvoiceActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of a recurring invoice. Groups domain events originated by changes to the recurrence itself (creation, activation, pause, resume, execution, failure, cancellation) and by the invoices it generates.

event_type.description: Tipo de evento de dominio (p. ej. `recurring_invoice.activated`, `recurring_invoice.executed`, `recurring_invoice.cancelled`).

metadata.description: Event metadata. Internal identifiers (PKs) are stripped; `*_uuid` values are preserved.

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

RecurringInvoiceLine.description: A line item on a recurring invoice template.

description.example: Cuota soporte mensual

retention.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

surcharge.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

exemption_reason.description: LIVA exemption / non-subjection cause of the line (subset of the E and N codes). `null` if not informed.

regime_key.description: VeriFactu regime key (`ClaveRegimen`, AEAT list L8.1) of the line. `null` if not informed.

retention_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the catalog tax applied as IRPF withholding to the line. Opaque: it does not take part in the `taxes`/`total` computation (the formula uses the flat `retention` percentage). `null` if not informed.

surcharge_rate_id.description: Public identifier (UUID v7) of the catalog tax applied as equivalence surcharge to the line. Opaque: it does not take part in the `taxes`/`total` computation (the formula uses the flat `surcharge` percentage). `null` if not informed.

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime override of the recurring template line: `iva`/`igic`/`ipsi` when set per-document (precedence override>zone), otherwise `null`. Writable on create/update; propagated to each generated invoice. The template must be homogeneous (a single non-null regime across all lines, 422 otherwise).

RecurringInvoiceStats.description: Aggregated summary of the recurring invoices of the authenticated company: counters by status, upcoming due dates, current-month generation/failures, breakdown by frequency, upcoming runs and estimated revenue. Returned by `GET /v1/recurring_invoices/stats`.

completed.description: Completed recurrences (reached `max_occurrences`). Reported as `0` until the repository provides the dedicated count.

due_today.description: Recurrences whose next run is today.

due_this_week.description: Recurrences whose next run falls in the current week.

generated_this_month.description: Invoices generated by recurrences during the current month.

failed_this_month.description: Ejecuciones de recurrencia fallidas durante el mes en curso.

frequency_breakdown.description: Recurrence count by frequency. Keys: `weekly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `yearly`, etc.

next_scheduled.description: Upcoming recurrences to run, ordered by run date ascending.

id.description: UUID (v7) de la recurrencia.

Series.description: A document numbering series. Immutable per AEAT compliance.

prefix.description: Legacy alias for code. Use code field. Will be removed in v2.

number_format.description: Canonical numbering mask describing how the document number is rendered: padding (the block of zeros), year token (`{YYYY}` 4 digits / `{YY}` 2 digits / omitted for no year), optional month token (`{MM}` 2 digits) and separator. Example: `{code}-{YYYY}-{000}` (default) or `{code}-{YYYY}-{00000}` for 5-digit padding. When `counter_reset` is `monthly`, the mask must include the `{MM}` token (e.g. `F-{YYYY}-{MM}-{000}`) so the rendered number stays unique across months; otherwise two months would both start at `1`. Set on creation and immutable afterwards. Mirrors Holded's `format`.

next_number.description: Next correlative that will be assigned on the next real emission.

current_number.description: Last correlative actually emitted in the current fiscal year (0 for a brand-new series).

initial_number.description: Number the counter starts from. Set on creation to continue an existing numbering when migrating (e.g. 235). Defaults to 1.

counter_reset.description: Counter reset policy (source of truth): `never` (the counter never resets), `annual` (resets on January 1st) or `monthly` (resets on the 1st of each month). `monthly` requires the `number_format` mask to include the `{MM}` token to keep rendered numbers unique across months.

year_reset.description: Deprecated alias of `counter_reset`. `true` is equivalent to `counter_reset: "annual"`, `false` to `counter_reset: "never"`. Use `counter_reset` instead; this field will be removed in v2.

SignDeliveryNoteRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — POST /v1/delivery_notes/{uuid}/sign.

Optional body: `signed_by` (alias of `recipient_name`, BC invariant),
`recipient_dni` (BC invariant — Spanish DNI/NIE, required by
`SignatureData`), `signature_image_base64` (raw base64 PNG; decode +
size + magic bytes are validated by the controller to respond 422
`payload_too_large`/`invalid_param_format`), `signed_at` (ISO 8601
optional, default now).

The controller converts `signed_by` → `recipient_name` and prefixes the
base64 with `data:image/png;base64,` before dispatching to the BC.

SimplifiedInvoiceEligibility.description: Result of checking whether an invoice can be issued as simplified (F2) under RD 1619/2012 art. 4.

can_be_simplified.description: Whether the invoice can be issued as a simplified invoice (F2).

must_be_complete.description: Whether the invoice must be issued as a full invoice (F1). It is the complement of `can_be_simplified`.

reason_code.description: Code of the blocking reason when it cannot be simplified (`intra_community`, `reverse_charge`, `export_operation`, `client_deduction_required`, `over_absolute_limit`). Empty string `""` when it can be simplified.

reason_message.description: Human-readable (Spanish) message of the blocking reason. Empty string `""` when it can be simplified.
reason_message.example: El importe 5.000,00 EUR supera el límite de 3.000,00 EUR para una factura simplificada.
examples: El importe 5.000,00 EUR supera el límite de 3.000,00 EUR para una factura simplificada.

StripeAutoinvoicedCorrective.description: A corrective invoice automatically generated from a Stripe refund (`charge.refunded`). The public `id` is the UUID (v7) of the corrective invoice; `original_invoice_id` links to the original invoice.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the corrective invoice. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `stripe_autoinvoiced_corrective` for this resource.

original_invoice_id.description: UUID (v7) of the original invoice that was corrected by the refund.

refund_id.description: Opaque refund identifier from the payment gateway (e.g. Stripe `re_xxx`).

provider.description: Payment gateway the refund originated from.

amount.description: Refunded amount in euros (the individual refund amount, not the cumulative).

correction_type.description: Scope of the correction: `total` (full annulment) or `partial` (a single negative line for the refunded amount).

created_at.description: When the corrective mapping was recorded (ISO 8601).

StripeAutoinvoicedPayment.description: A Stripe charge that generated an invoice (one-shot flows A/B and subscription cycles). The public `id` is the UUID (v7) of the payment; `invoice_id`/`client_id` link to the generated invoice and client. Subscription-origin context (`subscription_id`, `stripe_invoice_id`, `period_start`, `period_end`) is `null` for one-shot charges.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the payment record. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `stripe_autoinvoiced_payment` for this resource.

invoice_id.description: UUID (v7) of the invoice generated by this charge.

client_id.description: UUID (v7) of the invoice client, or `null` if not available.

stripe_reference.description: Stripe transaction reference of the payment record.

subscription_id.description: External Stripe subscription id (`sub_xxx`) when the charge comes from a subscription cycle; `null` for one-shot charges. This is an external Stripe id, NOT an internal UUID.

stripe_invoice_id.description: Stripe invoice id (`in_xxx`) of the billed cycle; `null` for one-shot charges.

period_start.description: Start of the billed subscription period (YYYY-MM-DD); `null` for one-shot charges.

period_end.description: End of the billed subscription period (YYYY-MM-DD); `null` for one-shot charges.

created_at.description: When the payment record was created (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: When the payment record was last updated (ISO 8601).

StripeAutoinvoicingConfig.description: Stripe Connect integration status and auto-invoicing configuration for your company. Singleton resource (one configuration per company), so it exposes `object` but no navigable `id`.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `stripe_autoinvoicing_config` for this resource.

connected.description: Whether the Stripe Connect integration is connected (active) for the company.

enabled.description: Whether auto-invoicing of Stripe charges is enabled. Defaults to `false`.

series_id.description: UUID (v7) of the document series used for auto-created invoices. `null` means the company default series is used.

available_for_current_plan.description: Whether the current plan includes auto-invoicing (effective plan gating, derived from config — not hardcoded).

required_plans.description: Plans that unlock auto-invoicing (derived from config, not hardcoded).

simplified_threshold_cents.description: Simplified invoice (F2) threshold in cents, range `[0, 300000]` (0–3,000 €). Charges without a tax ID at or below this amount are auto-issued as simplified invoices; above it they are routed to manual review. Defaults to 40000 (400 €).

require_nif.description: Whether a Spanish tax ID (NIF) is required for auto-invoicing. When enabled, Factuarea-created Checkouts mark the tax ID as required and charges without a tax ID are never auto-issued as simplified invoices (they go to manual review). Defaults to `false`.

refunds_enabled.description: Whether a Stripe refund (`charge.refunded`) automatically generates a linked corrective invoice (with the original invoice and the VeriFactu R record). Only acts while auto-invoicing is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled.description: Whether Stripe subscription cycles (`invoice.paid` with a standard `billing_reason`) are auto-invoiced. Both this toggle and the general `enabled` flag must be on for a cycle to be invoiced. Defaults to `false`.

StripeAutoinvoicingConfig.title: StripeAutoinvoicingConfig

StripePayout.description: A Stripe payout ingested from `payout.paid`, together with its bank-reconciliation state. The public `id` is the payout UUID (v7). `connected_account_id` (`acct_xxx`) and `stripe_payout_id` (`po_xxx`) are external Stripe ids, not foreign keys. `bank_transaction_ref` is the UUID (v7) of the reconciled bank statement transaction (`null` while `status` is `ingested`). `composition` is the informative breakdown reported by Stripe (component charges + fees), referencing opaque Stripe ids — payouts are read-only on the public API; reconciliation happens in the dashboard.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the payout. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `stripe_payout` for this resource.

connected_account_id.description: External Stripe connected account id (`acct_xxx`) the payout was paid out from. NOT an internal UUID nor a foreign key.

stripe_payout_id.description: Opaque Stripe payout identifier (`po_xxx`), unique in Stripe.

amount_net.description: Net amount transferred to the bank account (gross minus fees), in the payout currency.

fee_total.description: Total Stripe fees deducted from the payout.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code of the payout.

arrival_date.description: Expected arrival date of the payout in the bank account (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Reconciliation state. `ingested` once persisted; `reconciled` (terminal) once matched against a bank statement transaction.

reconciled_at.description: When the payout was reconciled against the bank statement (ISO 8601), or `null` while `ingested`.

bank_transaction_ref.description: UUID (v7) of the reconciled bank statement transaction, or `null` while `ingested`.

composition.description: Informative breakdown of the payout reported by Stripe (component charges and fees). Component references are opaque Stripe ids (`payment_intent` = `pi_xxx`, `charge_id` = `ch_xxx`), NOT internal payment UUIDs. May be empty when the breakdown could not be read.

StripePayout.title: StripePayout

Supplier.description: A supplier or vendor of your company.

business_name.description: Legal/business name / full fiscal name of the supplier (may match `name`).

commercial_name.description: Optional trade name (DBA), distinct from the legal name.

tax_id.description: Spanish fiscal identifier (NIF, CIF, NIE). Structural format: NIF `^\d{8}[A-Z]$`, NIE `^[XYZ]\d{7}[A-Z]$`, CIF `^[A-Z]\d{7}[A-Z0-9]$`. AEAT control-digit (checksum) validation is enforced when the request opts in via the `Factuarea-Version` header on or after the activation version; without that opt-in the legacy permissive behaviour is preserved. Mutually exclusive with `alternative_id`.

billing_emails.description: Additional emails for invoice delivery (administration, accounting). Maximum 5.

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates of the supplier. `null` when not recorded.

iban.description: Legacy alias for bank_accounts[].iban where is_default=true. Kept for backward compatibility with existing integrators; prefer reading `bank_accounts[]` for new consumers.

bank_accounts.description: Bank accounts associated with the supplier. Empty `[]` when there are none.

default_taxes_id.description: UUID (v7) of the default tax applied to the supplier.

default_discount.description: Default discount applied to the supplier (percentage).

default_vat_rate.description: Default VAT rate applied to the supplier (percentage).

is_surcharge_subject.description: Indica si al proveedor se le aplica recargo de equivalencia.

accumulate_347.description: Whether this supplier accumulates towards the annual Modelo 347 report (operations with third parties above the legal threshold).

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this supplier to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, distinct from the fiscal `tax_id`. Persistent ERP synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

rate.description: Applied tax rate, e.g. `21` for 21% VAT.

is_default.description: true if this is the default tax for its `type` (independent of the `default_for_documents` map).

TaxReportPreview.description: Preview (dry-run computation, without persisting any file) of a Modelo 303/347 for a period. Lets the integrator validate the amounts before generating the final report. Amounts are expressed in euro cents (integers).

cuota.description: Accumulated VAT amount for that rate, in cents.

totals.description: Aggregated totals of the declaration (amounts in cents).

clients_347.description: Operations with clients that exceed the Modelo 347 threshold (Modelo 347 only). Empty for Modelo 303.

partyName.description: Name or legal/business name of the client.

base.description: Total annual amount of operations, in cents.

quarters.description: Amount per quarter (quarter key → amount in cents).

suppliers_347.description: Operations with suppliers that exceed the Modelo 347 threshold (Modelo 347 only). Empty for Modelo 303.

partyName.description: Name or legal/business name of the supplier.

base.description: Total annual amount of operations, in cents.

quarters.description: Amount per quarter (quarter key → amount in cents).

invoice_count.description: Number of issued invoices considered in the period.

purchase_invoice_count.description: Number of purchase invoices considered in the period.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings detected during the computation (e.g. invoices with incomplete data).

TaxReportStats.description: Aggregated summary of the history of tax reports generated by the authenticated company: totals by type, by format, accumulated size and current fiscal period. Returned by `GET /v1/tax_reports/stats`.

TaxStats.description: Aggregated KPIs over the company tax catalog (includes global system taxes). Breakdown por `type` y por `external_reference` AEAT.

total.description: Total taxes visible to the company (system + custom).

system_count.description: Taxes from the global system catalog (`is_system=true`).

TaxTotals.description: Aggregated totals of a set of lines. Returned by `POST /v1/taxes/calculate-totals`. Total formula: `subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

subtotal.description: Sum of the taxable bases of all lines (EUR).

total_vat.description: Sum of the VAT of all lines.

total_surcharge.description: Sum of the equivalence surcharge of all lines.

total_retention.description: Sum of the withholding (IRPF) of all lines.

lines.description: Calculated breakdown for each received line, in the same order.

TaxTotals.title: TaxTotals

TaxTotalsLine.description: Calculated breakdown of a single line within `POST /v1/taxes/calculate-totals`.

subtotal.description: Taxable base of the line (quantity × price − discount).

surcharge_amount.description: Equivalence surcharge amount of the line.

total.description: Total of the line (subtotal + vat + surcharge − retention).

TaxTotalsLine.title: TaxTotalsLine

TaxUsage.description: Desglose del uso de un tax across bounded contexts. Permite decidir si es seguro borrar o desactivar un tax (`in_use=false` ⇒ delete seguro).

total_count.description: Aggregate sum of the 6 keys in `used_by`.

used_by.description: Count by consumer BC. Excludes `purchase_invoice_lines` (no FK) and `recurring_invoices` (JSON lines).

TaxUsage.title: TaxUsage

UpdateAccountPersonalizationRequest.description: Partial update of the account personalization; only the fields present in the body are applied. `language` is one of `es`, `en`, `ca`; `pdf_template` is a template slug; `accent_color` is a `#RRGGBB` hex color. Values outside the catalog return 422 with the accepted values.

language.description: Account issuing language (es, en or ca).

pdf_template.description: Invoice PDF template (slug from the template catalog).

UpdateAccountPersonalizationRequest.title: UpdateAccountPersonalizationRequest

UpdateClientRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/clients/{uuid}.

Partial PUT update: all fields are `sometimes`. If not sent, the handler
keeps the current value. If sent as `null`, the field is cleared
(when the domain allows it).

Accepts the same fields as `CreateClientRequest` V1 (see docblock there).
The validation of domain invariants (XOR `tax_id`/`alternative_id`,
direct_debit ⇒ default bank account, billing_emails without duplicates) is
performed by the `Client` aggregate. The typed exceptions propagate to the
`ExceptionRenderer` with the canonical v1 envelope.

type.description: Alternative identifier type from the AEAT L7 catalog. Legacy aliases (`tax_id_foreign`/`national_id`) are accepted on input for backward compatibility.

UpdateClientRequest.title: UpdateClientRequest

UpdateCompanyV1Request.description: Partial update of a managed child company profile (business name, fiscal address, contact details). Omitted fields keep their current value; send `""` to clear a field. `country_aeat_zone` is derived from the postal code, and `tax_id` is immutable after creation (sending it returns 422).

name.description: Trade name of the child company (1-255 characters).

business_name.description: Legal/registered business name of the child company.

email.description: Contact email of the child company.

UpdateCompanyV1Request.title: UpdateCompanyV1Request

UpdateConnectedAccountRequest.description: Update a connected Stripe account (multi-store). All fields are optional with merge semantics (an omitted field is left unchanged): `name`, `series_id` (auto-invoicing series UUID; `null` clears it back to the company default), `simplified_threshold_cents` (0-300000), `autoinvoicing_enabled`, `require_nif`, `refunds_enabled` and `subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled`.
UpdateConnectedAccountRequest.title: UpdateConnectedAccountRequest

UpdateDeliveryNotePublicLinkRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/delivery_notes/{uuid}/public-link.

Required body: `action` ∈ {revoke, activate, extend, reset}. `extend_days`
is required when `action=extend`.
UpdateDeliveryNotePublicLinkRequest.title: UpdateDeliveryNotePublicLinkRequest

Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/delivery_notes/{uuid}.

Partial update: omitted fields are kept. Only allowed when
the delivery note is in `draft` status (the controller maps the
transition exception to 422 `invalid_status_transition`).

vehicle_plate.description: Licence plate of the vehicle used for the delivery (up to 20 characters).

UpdateDeliveryNoteRequest.title: UpdateDeliveryNoteRequest

UpdateInvoicePublicLinkRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/invoices/{uuid}/public-link.

`SchemaName` sets a unique, clean OpenAPI schema name
(`UpdateInvoicePublicLinkRequest`), consistent with Quote/Proforma/DeliveryNote
for the same operation, without renaming the class.
UpdateInvoicePublicLinkRequest.title: UpdateInvoicePublicLinkRequest

UpdateInvoiceRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/invoices/{uuid}.

Partial update: omitted fields are kept. Only allowed when
the invoice is in `draft` status (the controller maps the
transition exception to 422 `invalid_status_transition`).
UpdateInvoiceRequest.title: UpdateInvoiceRequest

UpdateProductRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/products/{uuid}.

Full update (PUT). All fields `sometimes`: if not sent, the
handler keeps the current value. `sku` unique scoped to the company,
ignoring the product itself. Writable: `name`, `sku`, `price`,
`description`, `tags`, `low_stock_threshold` (per-product),
`currency` (EUR only — Producto is read-only EUR; any other code → 422),
`tax_rate_id`, `is_active`, `metadata`, `external_id`. `stock` is NOT
writable here (D1): stock mutation lives only in
`PUT /v1/products/{uuid}/stock` with its `set`/`increase`/`decrease`
semantics. Validation of `metadata` via VO `Metadata`.

currency.description: Product amounts are read-only EUR: only `EUR` (or absence/null) is accepted. Stock is not writable here; stock changes are made via `PUT /v1/products/{uuid}/stock`.

tax_rate_id.description:
`taxes` is a global system catalog (without a `company_id` column).
Do NOT use TenantRule here — it would add `WHERE company_id = X` against a
table without that column and cause a 500 (SQLSTATE 42S22). Global
validation by uuid, like in the rest of the BCs (DeliveryNote V1, etc.).

external_id.description: Third-party integration key from your ERP/CRM. Partial update: an absent value is preserved. Free-form, up to 100 characters; unique per company.

UpdateProductRequest.title: UpdateProductRequest

UpdateProductStockRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/products/{uuid}/stock.

Body: `{ stock: int, operation?: 'set'|'increase'|'decrease' }`.
`operation` defaults to `set` (replace). Accepts also `add` / `subtract`
as aliases for `increase` / `decrease` for ergonomics.
UpdateProductStockRequest.title: UpdateProductStockRequest

UpdateProformaPublicLinkRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/proformas/{uuid}/public-link.

`SchemaName` disambiguates the OpenAPI schema: Quote and Proforma declare
structurally identical request bodies, so without a unique name they would
collide in `components.schemas`.
UpdateProformaPublicLinkRequest.title: UpdateProformaPublicLinkRequest

UpdateProformaRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/proformas/{uuid}.

Partial update: omitted fields are kept. Only allowed when
the proforma is in `draft` status (the controller maps the
transition exception to 422 `invalid_status_transition`).
UpdateProformaRequest.title: UpdateProformaRequest

external_id.description: External business key (integration key from your ERP/CRM). Partial update: an explicit `external_id: null` clears the key. Orthogonal to `external_invoice_number`.

internal_notes.description:
Extend fields. Basic SHAPE only; the `payment_method` allowlist,
`tax_period` format and `tags` cardinality are validated by the
VO/Aggregate.

custom_fields.description: Typed custom fields as `[{field, value}]`. Partial update: an explicit `custom_fields: null` empties the collection.

retention_rate.description: Per-line IRPF retention and deductible VAT. Same shape rules as create.

surcharge_rate.description: Per-line equivalence surcharge (the legal VAT↔surcharge pair is validated) and LIVA exemption reason (closed catalog).

indirect_tax_regime.description: Per-line indirect tax regime of the supplier. Same shape rule as create (defense in depth); the real invariant lives in the domain.

UpdateQuotePublicLinkRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/quotes/{uuid}/public-link.

`SchemaName` disambiguates the OpenAPI schema: Quote and Proforma declare
structurally identical request bodies, so without a unique name they would
collide in `components.schemas`.
UpdateQuotePublicLinkRequest.title: UpdateQuotePublicLinkRequest

Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/quotes/{uuid}.

Partial update: omitted fields are kept. Only allowed when

UpdateQuoteRequest.title: UpdateQuoteRequest

UpdateRecurringInvoiceRequest.description: Partial update of a recurring invoice template; only the fields sent overwrite the current value, omitted ones are preserved. Writable fields mirror creation (`client_id`, `series_id`, `name`, `description`, `frequency`, `holiday_handling`, `start_on`, `end_on`, `notes`, `metadata`, `days_before_due`, `max_occurrences`, `email_to`, `send_automatically`, `lines[]`).
UpdateRecurringInvoiceRequest.title: UpdateRecurringInvoiceRequest

UpdateStripeAutoinvoicingConfigRequest.description: Update the Stripe auto-invoicing configuration. `enabled` toggles auto-invoicing; `series_id` (UUID, nullable) sets the series for auto-created invoices (`null` uses the company default); `simplified_threshold_cents` (0-300000), `require_nif`, `refunds_enabled` and `subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled` are optional partial fields.
UpdateStripeAutoinvoicingConfigRequest.title: UpdateStripeAutoinvoicingConfigRequest

UpdateSupplierRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/suppliers/{uuid}.

Partial PUT update: all fields are `sometimes`. If not sent, the
handler keeps the current value. If sent as `null`, the field is
cleared (when the domain allows it).

Accepts the same fields as `CreateSupplierRequest` V1 (see docblock there).
The validation of domain invariants (XOR `tax_id`/`alternative_id`,
direct_debit ⇒ default bank account, billing_emails without duplicates,
IBAN format, metadata limits) is performed by the `Supplier` aggregate and
the VOs. The typed exceptions propagate to the `ExceptionRenderer` with the
canonical v1 envelope.

type.description: Alternative identifier type from the AEAT L7 catalog. Legacy aliases (`tax_id_foreign`/`national_id`) are accepted on input for backward compatibility.

UpdateSupplierRequest.title: UpdateSupplierRequest

customer_visible_label.description: Custom label for this tax shown to the customer on documents (e.g. "IVA 21% incluido"). Up to 200 characters.

valid_until.description: End date of the tax validity window (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Must be on or after `valid_from`.

linked_surcharge_taxes_id.description: FK to the linked equivalence-surcharge tax; `null` unlinks it. UUID v7 value referencing the global `taxes` catalog.

default_for_documents.description: Sets this tax as the default per document type. Object with optional booleans: `invoice`, `quote`, `delivery_note`, `proforma`, `purchase_invoice`, `recurring_invoice`.

certificate_file.description: The digital certificate file in PKCS#12 format (`.p12` or `.pfx`).

UploadProductGalleryImageRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — POST /v1/products/{uuid}/gallery.

Multipart upload: `photo` or `image` (alias) field — jpeg/png/jpg/gif/webp,
max 3 MB.

We accept `image` as an alias of the canonical `photo` field for
forgiveness with integrators that send it following the more intuitive
convention. The controller normalizes it to `photo`.
UploadProductGalleryImageRequest.title: UploadProductGalleryImageRequest

UploadProductVideoRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — POST /v1/products/{uuid}/video.

Multipart upload: campo `video` (mp4/mov/avi/webm, max 50 MB).
UploadProductVideoRequest.title: UploadProductVideoRequest

VeriFactuEvent.description: A VeriFactu SIF event (Art. 8.1.b): a transmission/retry/AEAT-response entry of the system. The hash chain is never exposed here.

VeriFactuEventSummary.title: VeriFactuEventSummary

VeriFactuRecord.description: A VeriFactu (Spanish AEAT SIF) record (alta/anulación) associated with an invoice. Includes the hash chain (`huella`), AEAT CSV and transmission status for reconciliation.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the VeriFactu record.

invoice_type.description: AEAT invoice type (F1, F2, F3, R1-R5, …).

amount.description: Total amount of the associated invoice.

status.description: Transmission status (pending, submitted, accepted, rejected, error).

huella.description: Chained SHA-256 fingerprint of the record (VeriFactu fingerprint).

aeat_submission_id.description: Submission identifier assigned by AEAT (column `aeat_submission_id`). `null` until AEAT returns it. Never the internal PK of the record.

aeat_csv.description: Secure Verification Code (Código Seguro de Verificación) returned by AEAT on acceptance. `null` until AEAT assigns it.

transmitted_at.description: ISO 8601 date of the last transmission that reached AEAT. `null` in PENDING/REJECTED/ERROR states.

is_substitute_for_simplified.description: Whether it substitutes one or more simplified invoices (F3).

VeriFactuRecord.title: VeriFactuRecord

VeriFactuStats.description: Resumen agregado de los registros VeriFactu de la empresa autenticada: conteos por estado y desglose por tipo. Devuelto por `GET /v1/verifactu/stats`.

submitted.description: Records submitted to AEAT (without a final response yet).

by_invoice_type.description: Count by AEAT invoice type (F1, F2, F3, …).

last_transmission_at.description: Date of the last transmission to AEAT, or `null` if there is none.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `409 idempotency_key_reused`. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency).

FactuareaVersion.name: Factuarea-Version
FactuareaVersion.description: Pin the API version (`YYYY-MM-DD`, Stripe-style date versioning) for this request; omit to use the key's pinned version, or the latest if none. Unsupported version → `400 unsupported_api_version`; malformed → `400 parameter_invalid_format`. The effective version is echoed in the `Factuarea-Version` response header. See the [Versioning guide](/guides/versioning).

XActiveProfile.name: X-Active-Profile
XActiveProfile.description: Operate on behalf of a child company (gestoría master key): pass its public `id` (UUID v7) and the request runs against that child's data without changing the key's scope, tier or environment (omit to use the key's own company). Invalid UUID → `400 parameter_invalid_uuid`; unknown or non-owned id → `404 profile_not_found`. See the [Acting on behalf guide](/guides/acting-on-behalf).
